basic_details.scholarship_name: Romanian Government ARICE / MFA Scholarship Programme
basic_details.offering_entity: Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) & Agency for Investments and Foreign Trade (ARICE)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All accredited Romanian State Universities (University of Bucharest, POLITEHNICA Bucharest, Babeș-Bolyai, Technical University of Cluj-Napoca, Alexandru Ioan Cuza)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to almost all academic fields: Engineering, Computer Science, Architecture, Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, Economics, Humanities, Political Science. Excludes Medicine, Dental Medicine, and Pharmacy.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~500 scholarships awarded annually across non-EU partner nations
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible non-EU partner state (~30 to 50 Pakistani students selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's (3-6 years) + 1 preparatory year; Master's (1.5-2 years) + 1 preparatory year; PhD (3-4 years)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of non-EU countries (Pakistani citizens eligible; dual Romanian citizens strictly ineligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants under 35; PhD applicants under 45 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years (HSSC/FSc/A-Levels) for Bachelor's; 16 years (BS) for Master's; 18 years (MS/MPhil) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade 7.00 out of 10.00 (Romanian grading system, equivalent to at least 70% or 2.80/4.00 CGPA).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Secondary school or university education in relevant academic subjects.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final year of study.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic record carries the overwhelming selection weight.

english_proficiency.notes: No English test required. Studies are conducted in the Romanian language, preceded by a fully funded 1-year preparatory Romanian language course.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Preparatory year of Romanian language is mandatory (unless applicant already holds a Romanian language proficiency certificate B2).
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; all eligible candidates welcome.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if already benefiting from another Romanian state scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition fees covered for the preparatory language year and the entire duration of the degree program.

admission_application_fee.details: No university admission application fees; managed via ARICE/MFA centralized platform.

accommodation.details: Free student hostel / university dormitory accommodation provided through the Romanian Ministry of Education budget.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly allowance to cover personal study expenses.
monthly_stipend.amount: Bachelor: 65 EUR/mo; Master: 75 EUR/mo; PhD: 85 EUR/mo (subsidized alongside free dorm and tuition)

airfare.details: International airfare from Pakistan to Romania is paid by student/family.

visa_fee.details: Romanian long-stay student visa (type D/SD) is issued free of charge for scholarship holders.

health_insurance.details: Medical assistance in case of medical-surgical emergencies and acute illnesses provided by the Romanian state.

food_allowance.details: Access to subsidized university cafeterias and canteens across Romanian campuses.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental research facilities accessible for PhD scholars.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Domestic public transport and student train travel heavily discounted (50%–90% off) by Romanian student law.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for up to two universities and study options via the central portal.
participating_institutions: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iași
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Leading national public universities in Romania with strong engineering and science faculties.
available_majors: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, Economics, Business Administration, International Relations, Law, Physics, Chemistry, Biology
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Preparatory year (1 yr) + Bachelor's (3-4 yrs) / Master's (2 yrs) / PhD (3-4 yrs)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Handled centrally by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs / ARICE and Ministry of Education; letter of acceptance issued directly.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: POLITEHNICA Bucharest and Babeș-Bolyai in Cluj-Napoca are most competitive for engineering and computer science.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Learning Romanian in the preparatory year is mandatory and an incredible cultural asset for careers in the European Union.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: ARICE / Study in Romania MFA Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the official ARICE scholarship portal (studyinromania.gov.ro or arice.gov.ro), select degree level and target universities.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on the official portal during open window (January-March).
2. Upload certified copies of educational diplomas, transcripts, and birth certificate.
3. Upload Curriculum Vitae (Europass format) and Letter of Intent / Motivation Letter.
4. Submit complete electronic dossier by deadline (typically late April).
5. Evaluation board reviews academic scores and documents in May/June.
6. Results announced in July; Ministry of Education issues official Letter of Acceptance.
7. Apply for Romanian long-stay study visa (D/SD) free of charge at Romanian Embassy in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct centralized application through the ARICE / MFA portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Letters of recommendation uploaded directly by applicant if requested.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Letter of Intent detailing your academic motivation, reasons for choosing Romania, and future career plans.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a detailed research project (3-5 pages) approved by a Romanian doctoral supervisor.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard Europass CV format in English or French.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; selection is based strictly on academic dossier and grade averages.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Diplomas and transcripts must be authenticated by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan before visa issuance.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Authorized translations into English, French, Spanish, or Romanian.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Matric/FSc for Bachelor's; BS degree for Master's; MS/MPhil for PhD
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / HEC Pakistan and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA)

required_documents_checklist.specification: Transcripts showing all subjects and grades earned with official grading scale

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be valid for at least 1 year past entry date

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical certificate proving applicant is fit for study and free of infectious diseases
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by registered Pakistani government hospital
Detailing educational history and extracurricular activities

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Opens annually in January and closes late April. Academic year begins October 1 across Romania.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Overall grade point average across secondary or university education)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For PhD candidates: quality of proposed research plan)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint commission composed of representatives of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Economy, and Ministry of Education.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring of academic grades: Candidates are ranked based on GPA and allocated to available university seats.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid academic students seeking quality European education with low living overhead.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from all provinces of Pakistan (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan, Islamabad) enrolling in engineering, IT, and business.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Morocco, Egypt, Jordan, Nigeria, Vietnam, Brazil.

fake_websites_and_scams: Pakistani education agents charging PKR 300,000 to 500,000 claiming they have special quota links to the Romanian Embassy.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The Romanian Government scholarship application is 100% FREE. Never pay any agent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Apply directly on the official Romanian government portal without intermediaries.
hidden_costs_breakdown: International flight ticket to Bucharest (~PKR 180,000 to 250,000).
HEC / IBCC / MOFA attestation and translation fees in Pakistan (~PKR 30,000).
Monthly pocket money buffer (since the ~€65-85 stipend covers only basic expenses, students need ~€100-150/mo extra for food).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You will study in English. (Fact: Romanian government scholarships are almost exclusively in Romanian language; the 1-year language prep year is mandatory).
MYTH: You can study MBBS/Medicine. (Fact: Medicine, Dentistry, and Pharmacy are strictly excluded from this scholarship).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents falsely claim the stipend is €800/month; the official government stipend is €65 to €85/month alongside free tuition and free dorm.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all exams in the Romanian language preparatory year to proceed to the degree; must earn all required credits each academic year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance at host Romanian university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Failing an academic year results in permanent loss of scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: International students in Romania are legally permitted to work up to 4 hours per day (part-time) with a work permit.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; Romania is an EU member state and graduates can seek employment or pursue further studies in Europe.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing the preparatory language year or academic expulsion terminates scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing universities requires Ministry of Education approval and is generally only permitted after the preparatory year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not permitted once degree program begins.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions beyond normal study duration.
